## Code conventions review (`--review-pr`): `2480a2883d…HEAD`

**Mode:** `--review-pr`. I generated the full checklist from `docs/engineering/sources/rules.json` and went through every rule against the diff. It's 41 files, mostly Cypress deletions and fixes, plus three small `apps/web/src` changes. I wrote the checklist to the scratchpad instead of `docs/engineering/`, so no tracked files changed. I didn't need to look up any rule's review learnings or GitHub source.

**Rules that applied:** E2E-01, E2E-02, TEST-01, TEST-02, TEST-04, API-01, CODE-01 (plus the DRY principle in the root `AGENTS.md`), DOC-01 and REVIEW-01. None of the other rules touch this diff: auth, RTK, transactions, mobile, CI, security and the rest.

**Rules that passed:**
- **E2E-01:** renaming the chooser trigger to `open-add-accounts-chooser-button` fixes a duplicate test ID. `AddAccounts/index.tsx:384` still uses `add-space-account-button`.
- **TEST-04:** the Cypress row, expand and sub-account tests that were removed are covered by `AccountsWidget.test.tsx:65, 226, 279, 342`. The removed pending-widget tests were already inside a block comment. The only coverage gap is the chain-logo count.
- **API-01:** no consumers are left for `member-address-input`, `headerTestId`, `singleChainAccountRowIndex`, `sidebarTrustedSafesForSorting` or `staticSpaces.*.id`. The unit tests were updated for the renamed test ID.
- **REVIEW-01:** the production changes (test-ID rename and a section wrapper `div`) exist only to support the tests, so they're in scope. The wrapper sits in a plain block scroll container, so layout doesn't change.

### Findings

| # | Rule | Where | Finding | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | TEST-01 | `apps/web/cypress/e2e/regression/spaces_basicflow.cy.js:47`, `apps/web/cypress/e2e/pages/spaces.page.js:656`, `:555` | "Add account manually" no longer creates a new space. It adds `SEP_STATIC_SAFE_35` to whatever space comes first for OWNER_4 and never removes it. The last assertion (`dashboardSafeList contains shortened address`) passes on the next run even if adding breaks, because the Safe is already there from the previous run. It may also fail because the Safe is a duplicate. **Fix:** remove the Safe after the test, or target a fresh or dedicated space. | Medium |
| 2 | E2E-01 | `apps/web/cypress/e2e/pages/spaces.page.js:157`, `:276`; `apps/web/cypress/e2e/regression/spaces_dashboard.cy.js:38`, `:76` | `clickSingleChainAccountRow()` clicks the first single-chain row, but the test then checks it opened the `pendingTxAccount` Safe ("Pending tx"). That only works while the fixture space has exactly one single-chain row. Adding one would open a different Safe. **Fix:** target the row by name, e.g. `cy.contains(singleChainAccountRow, row.name)`. The fixture comment at `staticSpaces.js:45` still says "Row 2" even though the index was removed. | Low–Med |
| 3 | E2E-02 (plausible) | `apps/web/cypress/e2e/pages/spaces.page.js:573-574` | In `verifySpaceInviteBannerVisible`, the 30s timeout is on `cy.get(inviteBanner)`, but the check that actually waits is the chained `.contains(spaceName)`, which uses the 10s default. If an older invite banner already exists, the get resolves at once and the new space name gets only 10s. **Fix:** put the timeout on `.contains`, or use `cy.contains(inviteBanner, spaceName, { timeout })`. | Low |
| 4 | DRY / CODE-01 | `apps/web/cypress/e2e/pages/spaces.page.js:226-240` and `:661-670` | `goToSpacesView()` and `openFirstSpaceFromSpacesView()` repeat the same block: wait for `@spacesList`, check for a dashboard URL, click the logo, assert the URL. **Fix:** have `openFirstSpaceFromSpacesView` call `goToSpacesView()` (or a shared private helper) before `openFirstExistingSpace()`. | Low |
| 5 | TEST-01 | `apps/web/cypress/e2e/regression/assets.cy.js:47-56` | The "Default tokens" / "All tokens" regression test now asserts the same token list in both modes. The new comment says it mirrors `smoke/assets.cy.js:41-49`. The test can't fail if default-token filtering regresses, so it only duplicates the smoke test. **Fix:** delete it or move it to a portfolio-supported chain, as the comment suggests. | Low |
| 6 | API-01 (cleanup) | `apps/web/cypress/e2e/pages/spaces.page.js:143-145, 163, 202, 210, 279, 337, 365, 369`; `apps/web/cypress/fixtures/spaces/staticSpaces.js:23-40` | Deleting the tests left page-object exports with no callers: `txDetailsLabel`, `pendingTxName`, `pendingTxStatus`, `getPendingTxItem`, `signOutViaSidebarProfile`, `verifyOnSingleSpaceDashboard`, `clickExpandedPanelSubAccountRow`, `verifyAccountRowDetails`, `verifyExpandedPanelSubAccountRowsCount` and `verifyAccountExpandedPanelVisible`. Fixture fields `unnamedAccount*`, `multichainAccountRowIndex` and `multichainSubAccounts` are also unused. This doesn't match the stated "remove orphaned tests" goal. | Low |
| 7 | DOC-01 | `apps/web/cypress/support/localstorage_data.js:810`; `apps/web/cypress/fixtures/safes/static.js:30` | The `Used in:` comments were updated unevenly. `localstorage_data.js:810` still cites `sidebar3.cy.js, sidebar5.cy.js`: `regression/sidebar_5` was deleted and the real consumer is `safe_selector.cy.js:75`. `SEP_STATIC_SAFE_9` lost its consumer list although six specs still use it (`safe_selector`, `sidebar_new`, `prodhealthcheck/sidebar*`, `visual/sidebar`, `smoke/safe_selector`). | Low |
| 8 | TEST-02 | `apps/web/src/components/common/SpaceSafeBar/AccountsModal/index.tsx:53`; `apps/web/src/components/common/SpaceSafeBar/AccountsModal/index.test.tsx:136` | The `pinned-accounts` test ID moved from the section header to a wrapper around the whole section, and the Cypress helpers now depend on Safe cards being inside it (`accounts_modal.pages.js:39`, `:162`). No unit test checks that trusted items render inside `pinned-accounts`, so moving the test ID back to the header would pass the unit tests and break only Cypress. **Fix:** add a `within(getByTestId('pinned-accounts'))` assertion. | Low |

Nothing needs a code change before merge. Finding 1 is the one most likely to cause false passes or flakes. No convention docs, rule mappings or open questions changed.
